title: pi-everos settings
description: Settings for the EverOS Pi package. Never store EVEROS_API_KEY here.

enabled.description: When false, do not register MCP or inject the memory protocol.

mode.description: v1 only implements uvx. oauth is reserved.

projectId.description: EVEROS_PROJECT_ID, or auto from the workspace directory name

globalProjectId.description: EVEROS_PROJECT_ID for the global memory connection

assistantSenderId.description: EVEROS_ASSISTANT_SENDER_ID for cases and skills. Omit to use assistant-<userId>. Changing this hides experience stored under the previous id.

customText.description: Optional replacement for the user-memory protocol only. Still clipped by maxTokens. Does not replace the agent-experience section. Never put secrets here.
